Name: SVE Configs for Custom Kissing Mod
Author: brifoundthebingus
Description:
[size=3]Super simple mod that loads an additional config for Digus's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4664]Custom Kissing Mod[/url]. Made this mostly so I didn't have to redo the main config if the main mod changes and figured maybe other people would like to use it as well.

Install like any other mod, just extract the [CKM] SVE NPC Config folder into your mods folder.

If you have the "[b]EnableContentPacksOverrides[/b]" option disabled in the Custom Kissing Mod config, you can leave it disabled as that option is for resolving conflicts and as of right now the main mod does not contain these NPCs, so there shouldn't be any conflicts to resolve. If you already have it enabled for another reason, you can also leave it alone. This should take effect regardless of that setting unless a file or edit that directly conflicts with the addition of these NPCs is present (i.e. you already added them yourself to the main config, but at that point you could just remove them from the main config and stick with this mod, or vice versa).

You will need Digus's Custom Kissing Mod, Stardew Valley Expanded, and their dependencies for this content pack to work.

[/size]
